points.quote: In AFFiNE (BlockSuite), a document doesn't have a separate edgeless copy. Page mode and edgeless mode are two views of one Yjs block tree.
The other is `affine:surface`, which holds the whiteboard layer.
Shapes, brush strokes, connectors, text, mind maps and groups are not blocks. They are "surface elements" stored inside the single `affine:surface` block.
Page mode renders the notes as a linear document. Edgeless mode renders the same note blocks as movable cards on the canvas, and it also renders the surface.

Several block types can sit directly under the surface, as the `parent: ['affine:surface']` constraints in the block models show. These are frames, edgeless text, and in some cases bookmarks and attachments.
**Position and size:** `xywh` is a serialized string like `"[x,y,w,h]"`. ... Surface elements and the block-based edgeless items (notes, frames, edgeless text) use the same field.
**Stacking order:** `index` is a fractional-index string ... Elements are sorted by it ... It applies to blocks and elements alike

A group element (`GroupElementModel`) has a `children` Y.Map of `{childId: true}`. ... A frame block has `childElementIds: Record<string, boolean>`. Frames are containers with their own `xywh`, and they test containment by bounds.
